body: Agreement 6 of 10 from the Dimensional x AuDHD findings comparison (Overlap tab, Jayarr — Dimensional Profile). Matches: Finding #21: hot is a bidirectional filter failure; output loses its filter. Nature: consistency between two self-reports (the findings and a self-report app), not confirmation. Levels measured from the app's 5-segment bars.
doc_ref: Jayarr — Dimensional Profile (Claude Docs), Overlap tab
plain: Dimensional's impulsivity results (Impulsive in summary and Disposition, Emotionality High; Slow to Anger, Moderation and Deliberation Low) are compatible with, but do not establish, #21's unfiltered hot-state output; the Impulsive label does not establish ungated output (see the five-questions and Jargon Breaker runs).
status: consistency with AuDHD findings; content not ruled
